detailed_description:
The target video is original 2004 PlayStation 2 open-world gameplay footage with angular low-poly characters, flat painted textures, simple diffuse shading and warm hazy light, framed as vertical 9:16. Every person shares the same painted PS2 character style.
[Shot 1] <Subject 2>, the woman with the long black ponytail in the maroon sleeveless top, maroon leggings and white trainers, stands on the yellow exercise mat in the middle of <Subject 7>, facing the camera with her feet shoulder-width apart. Beside her on the right stands <Subject 4>, the woman with the short black bob in the black short-sleeve top with the small red mark on her left chest and black leggings, turned toward the girl. After a moment the girl begins slow, controlled bodyweight squats: she pushes her hips back, bends her knees over her toes and lowers until her thighs are almost level, raising both arms straight out in front of her, then rises back to standing as her arms lower. She repeats the same squat at the same steady rhythm, one every two and a half seconds, with both heels staying flat on the mat. The therapist watches closely, nods twice, then claps her hands together twice in encouragement and lowers her hands to her sides. Both women keep their hands, fingers and feet clearly visible, and each keeps her own face, hair and clothes. The camera starts at the front-left of the women and arcs slowly to the right around them with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping both full bodies in frame and the horizon level. The treatment plinth, wall bars and red exercise ball stay in place behind them. These two women are the only people in the room, and every surface keeps the painted PS2 look of <Subject 1>.

overall_soundscape:
Soft breathing with each squat, the gentle squeak of trainers on a rubber mat, two light hand claps and a quiet room tone.
